arguments.query: small business need help with data analysis or reporting

results.text: A small professional practice is publicly comparing several software subscriptions but lacks a consistent cost and feature analysis.
A small producer describes repeated shortages of inexpensive components alongside excess stock of rarely used parts.
A specialty seller has duplicated and inconsistent product descriptions across several public listings.

arguments.scope: A structured cost-and-feature comparison report of the software subscriptions the practice is evaluating. Deliverable: a table/document comparing each subscription option on price, key features, contract terms, and suitability notes, plus a short recommendation summary, based on publicly available information about the named products.

offers.scope: A structured cost-and-feature comparison report of the software subscriptions the practice is evaluating. arguments.scope: An inventory analysis report identifying which inexpensive components are frequently running short and which rarely used parts have excess stock, based on the producer's own descriptions/data. Deliverable: a document listing affected parts, a simple reorder-point suggestion for shortage-prone items, and a recommendation for reducing/liquidating excess rarely-used stock.

A cleanup pass on the specialty seller's public product listings: identify duplicated and inconsistent product descriptions across listings, deliver a corrected/standardized description for each affected product plus a short list of the inconsistencies found and recommendations to prevent recurrence, based on the publicly visible listing content.
